timing_policy.cold: new host process and fresh scratch per import; includes host startup/read/conversion; OS file caches NOT evicted
timing_policy.warm: persistent preheated host process, fresh helper and scratch per import; read/conversion wall clock inside host
timing_policy.order: fixture then temperature then repetition then helper mode then arm, ABAB for each mode; identical source bytes and mtimes
timing_policy.scope: checked AI-Off conversion, not SQLite publication or desktop interaction
